**Date:** March 31st 1888  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge IX 3

Dear [Madam](people/person_383.qmd),

The copy right of [Monthly packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) stories remains with the author, so that you are free to republish [King Pepito](other_books/otherbook_1053.qmd)

Yours truly
C.M. Yonge
